name: street-danforth
js: (() => { const C=window.CITY,a=window.__CITY_APP;const spot=(nx,nz)=>C.benchStats.sites.map(s=>({s,d:Math.hypot(s.x-nx,s.z-nz)})).sort((p,q)=>p.d-q.d)[0].s;const b=spot(4177,-2742);const r=C.nearestRoads(b.x,b.z,40)[0];const L=Math.hypot(r.px-b.x,r.pz-b.z)||1;const x=b.x+(r.px-b.x)/L*7,z=b.z+(r.pz-b.z)/L*7;a.cameraSystem.cinema=null;a.teleportTo(x,z,Math.atan2(b.x-x,b.z-z));a.selectCamera('pov',true);console.log('[ride-check] bench site '+JSON.stringify({id:b.id,x:b.x,z:b.z,street:b.frontage}));})()
